how: git clone --depth 1 over HTTPS and curl from raw.githubusercontent.com, through the session's network proxy. Downloads only. Every source sits in its own folder under the scratch work folder; nothing downloaded was executed; Python that reads the files ran with -I. sources/fetch.sh repeats the downloads at the recorded commits.
storedInRepository: none of the third-party files. Only checksums are kept here (the brief allows copies where the licence permits; the size limits for stored fixtures do not).
